personal_token.label: API token
personal_token.where: dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens - Create Token, then grant only the read permissions needed. Do not use a Global API Key.
notes: A Global API Key has full account access and cannot be scoped or revoked individually. A scoped API token can.
Verify a token before storing it with GET /client/v4/user/tokens/verify - it returns the token status without needing to know what it can reach.
Cloudflare has no OAuth flow for third-party apps; scoped API tokens are the supported mechanism and are strictly better than a key.
Permissions are granted per resource - a specific zone or account - rather than as a scope string, so the narrowing happens in Cloudflare's own token editor rather than here.

verify_token.label: Verify the API token
verify_token.notes: Call this on connect; it is the cheapest way to confirm a token works and has not been revoked.

rate_limits.note: Per user, across the whole API. Returns 429.
